templates.title: ONLINE SELLER BUSINESS MANAGER
templates.description: Online Seller Business Manager is an all-in-one Google Sheets template designed to simplify and organize your online selling business. Manage your orders, products, inventory, sales, expenses, customers, revenue, and profits from one centralized workspace. Whether you sell through marketplaces, social media, or your own online store, this ready-to-use template helps you keep your business data organized, save time, and get a clear view of your overall business performance.

faq.question: What is the Online Seller Business Manager?
faq.answer: It is an all-in-one Google Sheets template designed to help you manage your online selling business from one centralized workspace.
You can manage orders, products, inventory, sales, expenses, customers, revenue, and profits.
faq.question: What can I manage with this template?
Do I need any special software?
faq.answer: No. You only need Google Sheets and a Google account to use the template.

faq.question: Is this suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes. The template is designed to be simple, user-friendly, and easy to customize, even if you have limited spreadsheet experience.
Yes. You can easily customize the sheets according to your business needs.
faq.question: Can I customize the template?

faq.answer: Yes, absolutely. The template comes with a comprehensive, step-by-step PDF setup guide. You can set up the database and run the store locally on your machine in under 5 minutes with just standard npm commands.
faq.question: Is this template beginner-friendly to set up?
Can I test payments without having an active Razorpay account?
faq.answer: Yes. The codebase includes a built-in mock payment simulator. You can test the entire checkout, payment completion, receipt generation, and order placement flow locally without creating third-party payment accounts.

faq.question: How do I access the Admin Dashboard?
faq.answer: To keep your store secure, there is no public admin button on the storefront. You can access it directly by entering http://localhost:3000/admin in your browser and logging in with the default admin credentials provided in the setup guide.

faq.question: Which database is used and how do I change the credentials?
faq.answer: It uses PostgreSQL powered by Prisma ORM. All database connections and API keys are cleanly isolated in a .env.example file. You simply provide your local or cloud PostgreSQL connection URL, and migrations run automatically.

faq.question: Can I customize the branding, colors, and products?
faq.answer: Yes, 100%. You have full ownership of the source code. You can easily update the store name, replace the logo, adjust Tailwind CSS theme colors, add your custom categories, and upload unlimited products via the admin panel.

templates.description:
Dress UP is a production-ready, full-stack luxury fashion and apparel e-commerce store built with the modern tech stack. 
Whether you want to launch your own fashion brand, streetwear label, clothing store, or deliver an e-commerce platform for clients, this template provides everything out-of-the-box.

TECH STACK ------------
Framework : Next.js 14 (React 18 + App Router + Server Actions)
Database : PostgreSQL (via Prisma ORM)
Styling : Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons
Authentication : Custom JWT Session Authentication (Secure HttpOnly Cookies)
Payments : Razorpay Node.js SDK
Mailing : Resend Email API for OTPs & Alerts
TypeScript : 100% Type-Safe Codebase
included_items: 💳 Pre-Integrated Razorpay Payment System (+ Dev Mock Mode)

templates.description: A complete, production-ready AI-powered Campus Helpdesk and Academic Automation system. Equipped with a 24/7 Telegram Bot, RAG-powered AI knowledge retrieval, Student & Faculty Portals, Exam Scheduling, and interactive weekly timetables. Built on FastAPI, React 18, Tailwind CSS, and ChromaDB vector search to automate college admissions, fee policies, hostel rules, and student queries with zero hallucinations.

faq.question: Can this system be customized with a college's own rules and branding?
faq.answer: Yes, absolutely. The system is 100% white-label. You can upload any college's policy documents (attendance, fees, hostel rules) directly into the Admin Knowledge Base, and the AI will immediately adopt that institution's specific rules without modifying any code.

faq.question: Do students need to install an app to use the AI bot?
faq.answer: No installation is required. Students can interact directly via Telegram on their smartphones or access the web-based Public Campus Hub from any phone, tablet, or laptop browser.

faq.question: What are the prerequisites to run this project?
faq.answer: Python 3.10+ and Node.js v18+. A free Google Gemini API key is used for AI embeddings and answers, and Telegram BotFather provides the bot token in under 2 minutes.

faq.question: Is the database pre-loaded with demo data?
faq.answer: The database is delivered 100% clean and ready for production deployment. Pre-formatted bulk CSV templates for 120+ students, faculty, exams, and timetables are included for 1-click importing.

faq.question: Can I resell this system to multiple schools and colleges under my own brand name?
faq.answer: Yes! You receive 100% full source code and unrestricted commercial usage rights. You can rebrand it with your agency logo, customize it for unlimited educational clients, and charge them setup fees or monthly maintenance.
